source_scope: All three source files once for every condition; Rust adds measured binary and original metadata; shared Store/core/Python/SQLite/OS and filesystem metadata excluded
native_scope: Exact old candidate binary measured; separately published measured archive, current CI binaries tested functionally only
model_scope: No API or new answers; all later corpus edits are controlled work-copy changes, not new science or model quality
analysis_portability: Optional native-library path override verifies the same bytes and leaves timing/scoring unchanged
